item.title: Jeremy Jordan and Isa Briones Debut New ‘Just in Time’ Tracks: ‘It Just Made Sense’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our latest episode, where we're diving into the world of Broadway and the hit musical "Just in Time". This show about the life and loves of legendary crooner Bobby Darin has been wowing audiences since its opening in April 2025.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: The original leading man, Jonathan Groff, received a Tony nomination for his performance, but since his departure, the show has continued to thrive with a new cast. Jeremy Jordan, known for his Tony-nominated role in "Floyd Collins", took over as Bobby Darin on April 21st. And Isa Briones, who's had a stint in "Hadestown", joined the cast as Connie Francis, Darin's collaborator and romantic interest.
[Music transitions to a clip of Jeremy Jordan singing]
Host: The audience response to Jordan and Briones has been overwhelming, and to celebrate, Atlantic Records is releasing four brand new singles featuring the duo. You'll get to hear their duet "First Real Love", Jordan's takes on "Dream Lover" and "Mack the Knife", and Briones' rendition of "Who's Sorry Now".
[Music transitions to a clip of Isa Briones singing]
Host: We spoke with the stars, and they shared their excitement about developing the onstage chemistry between Bobby and Connie. Briones praised Jordan, saying "he's always playing and trying new things, which keeps you on your toes". Jordan added that he loves the process of discovery and that Briones is "leaning into that with me".
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: A video of Briones singing "Who's Sorry Now" recently went viral, generating 9 million views across platforms. This inspired the release of the new singles, even though the original cast recording has already been released. As Briones said, "it was so exciting to see how well it was received, and I think it just made sense to release them as full tracks".
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Be sure to check out the new singles from "Just in Time" on streaming platforms, and catch the show on Broadway to experience the magic for yourself. Thanks for tuning in!
